name: blueprints_schedule_to_string
notes: Parsed-schedule dict rendered back to a human string. Traced copy of src/tools/blueprints.c::cli_tools_blueprints__schedule_to_string vs LIVE tools/blueprints.py::_schedule_to_string. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (avoided in inputs): (1) LIVE treats an empty-string cron expr as falsy and falls through to the daily fallback while the C port prints it whenever non-NULL; (2) an unknown kind with an expr set prints the expr in C but hits the fallback LIVE. Also excluded: plain-string schedules (C port only sees parsed dict fields).
